subject: DigitalBank SIG package and evidence collection plan
messages:
From: Jamie Brooks <jamie.brooks@digitalbank.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@digitalbank.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire + evidence request (DigitalBank renewal)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this. We're starting the security review for our annual vendor renewal and need a completed SIG questionnaire plus supporting artifacts. High-level asks: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period), ISO 27001 certificate (if held), completed SIG v2024 questionnaire, and control evidence for any "Yes" answers.

Deadline: we'd like everything in-hand by Nov 30 to make the compliance committee on Dec 3. Can you confirm what you can provide and estimated delivery? Also, we prefer secure links (SFTP/secure Drive) over email attachments.

Example items we often need: network diagrams, encryption configuration screenshots, SOC 2 report or bridge letter, IAM policy excerpts, vulnerability scan summaries, retention policy, and an artifact manifest mapping control IDs to files.

Appreciate a quick plan.

Thanks,
Jamie Brooks
Vendor Risk Manager | DigitalBank
From: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
To: Jamie Brooks <jamie.brooks@digitalbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence request (DigitalBank renewal)

Jamie — thanks for the note and the clear list. We can meet the Nov 30 timeline with the following deliverables:

- Completed SIG v2024 spreadsheet with control answers and mapping to our SOC 2/ISO artifacts (attached: redwood_SIG_control_map_v1.xlsx).
- SOC 2 summary and bridge letter (attached: redwood_SOC2_summary_2026-11.pdf). Full SOC 2 Type II report is scoped for restricted distribution; we can provide it via a secure download once we have the NDA/procurement ticket confirmed.
- Evidence manifest (CSV) that lists each control ID, evidence file name, and access instructions (attached: evidence_manifest_20261129.csv).
- Secure Drive link for artifacts and screenshots (sharing set to View + watermarked PDF export).

Quick notes on a few items you mentioned:
- ISO 27001: currently in scope for gap remediation; we do not yet hold a certificate. We can provide our ISO control mapping and remediation plan in the Drive folder.
- Vulnerability scans: we will include the latest authenticated scan summaries and our patching cadence document.

Next steps from our side: Marissa (security lead) and Neha (compliance ops) will review the mapping and redact any customer-specific logs before upload. Please confirm the best secure delivery method for the SOC 2 report and whether the procurement team will sign a standard NDA.

Attachments: redwood_SIG_control_map_v1.xlsx (worksheet), redwood_SOC2_summary_2026-11.pdf (summary), evidence_manifest_20261129.csv

Best,
Chloe Martin
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference — Inference for production
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Jamie Brooks <jamie.brooks@digitalbank.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence request (DigitalBank renewal)

Chloe / Neha — looping in a quick checklist for what we'll upload and notes on redaction: 

- redwood_SIG_control_map_v1.xlsx: I'll add a column "Evidence location" with Drive filenames and mark anything with customer PII for redaction.
- SOC2: We will not email the full report. We can add a signed bridge letter to the package and provide the full report via an expiring secure link (watermarked).
- ISO artifacts: provide control gap matrix and remediation ETA; label as "NOT CERTIFIED" in the manifest.
- Vulnerability scans: include summary PDFs (high/critical findings only) and a sanitized scan export.

Action items:
1) Chloe: confirm procurement contact and NDA path.
2) Neha: prepare Drive folder, set permissions to DigitalBank procurement emails, enable download audit.
3) Marissa: redact logs, produce manifest.

Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Brooks <jamie.brooks@digitalbank.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@digitalbank.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence request (DigitalBank renewal)

Chloe / Marissa — this plan works. Procurement can sign the standard vendor NDA. Please send the DocuSign link for the NDA to procurement@digitalbank.com and cc me; once that's back, we'll accept the secure link for the SOC 2 report.

Also: could you include a short note that explains how you handle live model telemetry (what we send for inference, retention period, and whether any telemetry is used for training)? That's a key question from our privacy team.

Thanks — timeline is still Nov 30 for the package.

—Jamie
From: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
To: Jamie Brooks <jamie.brooks@digitalbank.com>
Cc: procurement@digitalbank.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence request (DigitalBank renewal)

Jamie — good to confirm procurement will handle the NDA. Next update:

- DocuSign NDA link: https://docusign.example.com/link/ND A-DB-2026-0927 (shared with procurement).
- Drive package: https://drive.redwood.example.com/secure/DB-SIG-package-2026-11-29 (access granted to procurement@digitalbank.com, expiring link 2026-12-15).
- Included files: redwood_SIG_control_map_v1.xlsx, redwood_SOC2_summary_2026-11.pdf (bridge letter), evidence_manifest_20261129.csv, vuln_summary_highcrit.pdf, iso_gap_matrix_20261122.pdf.
- Telemetry note (summary): Redwood Inference accepts inference payloads over TLS. We retain request/response telemetry for up to 30 days by default for debugging and billing, configurable by customer; telemetry is never used to train models without explicit customer opt-in and contractual terms. Full privacy/control details are in the privacy section of the Drive package.

If you confirm receipt of the NDA and that procurement has access, we'll mark the thread resolved and stand by for any follow-up questions from your privacy or infosec teams.

Attachments: none (all artifacts in secure Drive).

Best regards,
Chloe Martin
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
notes: All internal participants are Redwood employees listed under sources/gmail. External participants are DigitalBank procurement and security. Package assembled and shared via secure Drive; SOC 2 full report distributed on NDA via expiring link.
